leads.title: Burundi Penal Code, Article 567 (unofficial English translation)
leads.documents: Criminalization of same-sex sexual activity by men and women; penalty of 3 months to 2 years imprisonment and 50,000 to 100,000 francs fine
leads.detail: Penal Code passed in November 22, 2008, and took effect on 22 April 2009

leads.title: Burundi Constitution, Article 29
leads.documents: Constitutional ban on same-sex marriage; non-recognition of same-sex marriage and civil unions
leads.detail: Cited as Article 29 of the Burundi Constitution bans same-sex marriage

leads.title: U.S. Department of State - Country Reports on Human Rights Practices for 2016 (Burundi)
leads.documents: U.S. government human-rights assessment of violence, discrimination and other abuses based on sexual orientation and gender identity, penalties, prosecutions, and LGBTI services
leads.detail: Section titled Acts of Violence, Discrimination, and Other Abuses Based on Sexual Orientation and Gender Identity

leads.title: Burundi Africa Generation News
leads.documents: Report of prosecution for homosexuality cited as source for 2 November sentencing
leads.detail: Cited via State Dept report: According to Burundi Africa Generation News, on 2 November, the High Court of Cibitoke Province sentenced...

leads.title: High Court of Cibitoke Province - 2 November 2016 ruling
leads.documents: Court ruling sentencing a 15-year-old boy who admitted rape of a seven-year-old boy to one year in prison on charges of rape of a minor and homosexuality
leads.detail: Date: 2 November 2016; Cibitoke Province; one year imprisonment

leads.title: French government website on adoption
leads.documents: Adoption eligibility stating single and married people are eligible to adopt; no statement on whether single LGBTQ people are disqualified
leads.detail: Described as a website of the French government - does not say whether single LGBTQ people are disqualified or not

leads.title: International Gay and Lesbian Human Rights Commission - Burundi information
leads.documents: External human-rights resource for Burundi LGBTQ information
leads.detail: Listed under External links: International Gay and Lesbian Human Rights Commission - Burundi information - no URL visible in text

leads.title: Statement by President Evariste Ndayishimiye - December 2023
leads.documents: Presidential anti-gay enforcement rhetoric calling gay sex like choosing Satan, death penalty morally appropriate, and advocating taking gay people to stadiums to be stoned
leads.detail: December 2023 quote: For me, I think that if we find these people in Burundi they should be taken to stadiums and be stoned, and doing so would not be a crime.

leads.title: Remuruka Center in Bujumbura (as referenced in 2016 State Dept report)
leads.documents: Local LGBTI support infrastructure offering urgent services; government neither supported nor hindered activities of local LGBTI organizations or the center
leads.detail: Cited in State Dept excerpt: The Remuruka Center in Bujumbura offered urgent services to the LGBTI community.
